question: Does extending only the corrected BRRK-0011 CVaR/CDaR scale-selector upper bound above 1.0, while preserving the entire frozen directional/risk model, improve after-cost long-run compounded wealth without violating operating drawdown, 70% catastrophe, tail-risk, stress, liquidation-distance or robustness constraints?

only_structural_change.rule: Generalize the same corrected path-tail selector to search scale in [0, candidate_upper_bound]. Do not change V1 relative weights, HMM, semantic states, return-distribution fit, Student-t family, risk-off posterior logic, risk budget, rebalance semantics or contribution handling.
only_structural_change.cap_1_parity_gate: candidate_upper_bound=1.0 must reproduce the frozen corrected baseline before any >1 result is considered valid

why_search_stops_at_1_30.interpretation: historical research-only ceiling hint, not a promoted parameter and not production authorization
why_search_stops_at_1_30.rule: Any study above 1.30 requires a new experiment ID and new preregistration before execution.

operating_budget_rule: For each candidate budget, select at most one leverage-cap candidate using only the preregistered objective and constraints. No budget may be interpreted as a target drawdown. The 70% catastrophic boundary is never an operating candidate.

objective.primary: maximize after-cost long-run compounded terminal wealth / CAGR

transaction_cost_treatment.fifty_bps_role: extreme diagnostic stress inherited from prior robustness audit
transaction_cost_treatment.rule: Candidate and <=1 baseline must be recomputed under the identical cost assumption. No candidate receives a cheaper cost model.

mandatory_panels.name: HYPERLIQUID_NATIVE_ALL_PERP_COMMON_WINDOW
mandatory_panels.purpose: conservative native-venue funding lower-bound implementation panel

mandatory_panels.name: BINANCE_FULL_HISTORY_PROXY
mandatory_panels.purpose: sign/regime/full-history stress proxy only; never a Hyperliquid funding-level point estimate

spot_router_diagnostic.rule: May be reported as a routing diagnostic only. Missing historical spot fees/basis/slippage prevent treating zero-funding spot curves as deployable net PnL.

funding_treatment.missing_data_rule: Do not fill missing native funding with zero or silently substitute Binance levels. Missing required native-cost evidence blocks production promotion.

historical_stress_windows.name: 2021_SPRING_CRASH
historical_stress_windows.rule: If full BRRK is not legally eligible under the frozen minimum-training rule, apply the maximum candidate gross cap to frozen V1 relative exposure for stress survivability only; do not label this full-BRRK OOS performance.

historical_stress_windows.name: 2024_APRIL_MASKING_EPISODE
historical_stress_windows.source: AUDIT-0025 preregistered April trend audit window

historical_stress_windows.name: 2025_MULTI_PEAK_DELEVERAGING
historical_stress_windows.rule: Evaluate the full calendar year and mechanically report the three largest non-overlapping peak-to-trough drawdowns; do not hand-pick subwindows from leverage PnL.

synthetic_stress_suite.execution_rule: No favorable same-day rebalance is assumed inside a one-day gap shock.

liquidation_distance.model_source: canonical Hyperliquid margin/leverage tiers and instrument metadata snapshotted and hashed before first leverage-search run
liquidation_distance.acceptance: No modeled liquidation in any historical or synthetic stress. Report minimum adverse-move distance to modeled liquidation; it must exceed the largest applicable preregistered one-day gap stress for the evaluated position mix.
liquidation_distance.production_note: Research survival does not authorize a live leverage setting.

benchmark_comparison.required_parity: cap=1.0 path must reproduce baseline weights/equity/metrics within deterministic numerical tolerance
benchmark_comparison.dominance_rule: A >1 candidate must not be dominated by the simpler <=1 baseline on matched after-cost economics and selected operating-risk constraints.

promotion_success_conditions: cap=1.0 reproduces the frozen <=1 baseline before any >1 comparison is accepted
after-cost long-run compounded wealth is strictly higher than the <=1 baseline under matched 5 bps and 10 bps transaction-cost cases
candidate is not dominated by the <=1 baseline under the 20 bps adverse implementation-cost case
selected operating drawdown budget is respected and is one of 35/40/45/50 percent
70 percent catastrophic drawdown boundary is never breached
corrected scenario CVaR95 and CDaR95 remain <=20 percent at every leverage decision
all historical and synthetic stress windows pass their preregistered evaluation without modeled liquidation
liquidation-distance evidence is available and passes; missing venue margin evidence fails closed
stationary-block and start-date robustness thresholds pass
Hyperliquid native funding common-window economics are reported; Binance proxy alone cannot support promotion
candidate uses no new alpha, funding signal, short target, XRP target, EXPOSURE-SMOOTH-0038 substitution or P5 exit logic
failure_conditions: scenario CVaR95 or CDaR95 budget breach at a selected decision
modeled liquidation in any mandatory historical or synthetic stress
after-cost wealth does not improve at both 5 bps and 10 bps matched-cost cases
candidate is dominated by <=1 baseline at 20 bps
promotion case depends on Binance funding as a Hyperliquid level estimate
promotion case depends on zero-funding spot treatment without historical spot cost evidence

deployment_cap_rule.rule_if_research_candidate_eventually_pr: live cap must be the next lower preregistered cap grid point than the selected research cap and may never exceed 1.20 under LEVERAGE-0039; a selected research cap of 1.10 therefore implies live cap 1.00
deployment_cap_rule.raising_rule: Any later increase requires fresh evidence, a separately versioned deployment-cap decision and separate production authorization.

stopping_rule: Run the preregistered candidate caps/budgets/cost/stress suite once. Do not retune search caps, operating budgets, thresholds, stress windows, funding treatment or robustness gates after seeing results. A material change requires a new experiment ID.
forbidden: run leverage search before this preregistration is committed
change BRRK-0011 relative target weights or HMM/regime features
change 20 percent scenario tail budget in this experiment
search above gross 1.30 under this experiment ID
add shorts or XRP target exposure
authorize production leverage or production trading
required_result_artifacts: selection/failure decision with no post-result retuning

hypotheses.H1: Some corrected-risk cap in (1.0,1.30] improves matched after-cost compounded wealth while satisfying all preregistered constraints.
hypotheses.H0: No cap above 1.0 satisfies the complete promotion gate; preserve <=1 baseline.
